recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-37853 unless the Vocabulary WG later chooses to change the current THO external_code_systems.html link or further reduce the convenience table.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting updates to the Terminologies - Code Systems page so FHIR core treats THO as the source of truth for external code and identifier system information. The requested edits narrowed the URI preference rule to FHIR-defined code systems, removed the identifier-system cross-reference and external-terminology notes, added THO authority/convenience-copy language, revised the downloads sentence to HL7 code systems, and pruned Defined Externally rows without Using X With FHIR documentation.
initial_application: Commit 736ccce2005fd2c8c2d20dfe8df948e8c9d586d8, 'Applied FHIR-37853', changed source/terminologies-systems.html with the requested wording and removed many external rows lacking usage pages.
additional_context: The source page is part of the current build/navigation through source/terminology-module.html and source/documentation.html. Vocab tracker minutes from 2022-08-08 state that FHIR-37853 had been applied and that remaining external terminology tickets were moved to HTA or no longer core-spec work. Commit 6bbb8cc01d2eba1233e171cb0a3429d958926280 later changed the THO link from external_terminologies.html to external_code_systems.html, preserving the issue intent with the current THO page name.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/terminologies-systems.html contains the requested FHIR-only URI preference wording, identifies the external table as non-authoritative convenience content, points to THO External Code Systems for authoritative external terminology information, uses the revised HL7-code-systems downloads sentence, and keeps only external rows with terminology.hl7.org usage links. The obsolete identifier-system statement, the ISO URN/multiple-systems notes, removed example rows, and external_terminologies.html link are absent.
